events.address: Madison Square Park, 11 Madison Ave, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: A four-day free US Open fan experience in Madison Square Park with an IBM serve-speed simulator, AI-enabled ping pong, an AI photo booth, live finals viewing and official US Open merchandise.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the fan experience, tennis activations, AI experiences and live viewing is free. Merchandise is available separately and is not included.
events.caveats: Current sources agree that the Madison Square Park experience is free and separate from ticketed play in Flushing. Normal park capacity and event rules still apply.
events.practical_notes: Thursday September 10: 11 AM–9 PM; Friday September 11: 9 AM–9 PM; Saturday September 12: 11 AM–8 PM; Sunday September 13: 11 AM–7 PM. No ticket or registration requirement is stated for the park experience.

events.what_it_is: A five-floor immersive fall-flavor pop-up for Alani Nu's Witch's Brew, Ruby Apple and Voodoo Vanilla with themed mocktails, product sampling and rooftop programming.
events.what_is_free: The experience includes themed mocktails and samples of Alani Nu's fall lineup; exact quantities and availability are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: NYC Plugged states RSVP below and 18+. No approval language is published, so this is classified as a free RSVP rather than approval-required. Samples and rooftop programming remain subject to on-site availability and capacity.
events.practical_notes: Saturday September 12 and Sunday September 13 from 9 AM–7 PM at 214 Lafayette Street. The event page itself contains the RSVP flow.

events.address: Jack & Charlie's No. 118, 118 Greenwich Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW Maison Perrier pop-up with an on-site resident seamstress creating custom hat-and-scarf combinations inspired by French style.
events.what_is_free: The current event listing advertises free on-site custom hat-and-scarf combinations. Availability is not stated as unlimited, so treat the giveaway as subject to supply and capacity.
events.caveats: Average Socialite describes the activation as open to the public. The venue's official site independently confirms Jack & Charlie's No. 118 at 118 Greenwich Avenue. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 from 11 AM–5 PM at Jack & Charlie's No. 118, 118 Greenwich Avenue.
